League of Villains.text: A villain group so new and small that almost no one has heard of it. Its leader, Tomura Shigaraki, is a gaunt, restless young man who wears severed hands on his face and body, scratches his neck when frustrated and talks about villainy in video-game terms. Kurogiri, a polite man of dark mist whose Quirk opens warp gates, manages him, tends their hideout bar and moves people in and out. The rest are hired thugs found through brokers, and the man Shigaraki calls Sensei backs them all. Their aim is to kill All Might and bring down the hero society he holds up. The few brokers who deal with them see a strange client with money and big talk. The visible contradiction: a League with two real members at the start of the year, led by a man who has never led anyone.
